summary: The root م-ش-ي primarily means to walk or go on foot. It can also imply proceeding, journeying, or moving forward in a general sense.

headwords.def: مَشَى He walked, went, or went along; (MA, KL;) [in its primary sense] He went any pace upon his feet, afoot, or on foot; he footed; whether quickly or slowly: (Mgh, Msb:) he removed from place to place at pleasure: (Er-Rághib:) walked; went along, marched; travelled; trod; paced; stepped. See 5. مَشَى also signifies He went on, or continued, in his course of action, &c. (Mughnee voce أَنْ , in explanation of this verb as used in Kur xxxviii. 5.) [ مَشَى (assumed tropical:) It (money) passed; was, or became, current. (assumed tropical:) It (a calumny) was, or became, current. See مِئْبَرٌ .] مَشَى بَنْطُهُ [ His belly became moved, or in motion; it discharged itself. ] (S, K, art. طلق ; &c.)

headwords.gloss: He walked; went on foot, with him: he kept pace with him

parts.t: went on foot, with him: he kept pace with him.

headwords.def: مَاشَاهُ He walked, or went on foot, with him: he kept pace with him. See an ex. voce الأَحْصَّانِ .

headwords.gloss: The medicine moved; purged, his bowels; made his belly to discharge itself

parts.t: purged, his bowels; made his belly to discharge itself:

headwords.def: أَمْشَىَ الدَّوَآءُ بَطْنَهُ (A, K, art. حدر ,) [ The medicine moved, or purged, his bowels; made his belly to discharge itself: ] and البَطْنَ . (TA, art. طوس , &c.)

headwords.def: تَمَشَّى i. q. مَشَى : (TA:) [or, properly, and accord. to general usage, he walked with slow steps: so I have rendered it voce دَلَفَ , &c.:] he walked heavily, with an effort. (TK voce تَزَحَّفَ .) [One says in the present day, خَرَجْتُ أَتَمَشَى I went forth taking a walk; and تَمَشَّى He walked; walked about. ] [Hence the saying,] تَمَشَّتْ فِيهِ حُمَيَّا الكَأْسِ [ The intoxicating influence of the cup of wine pervaded him, or] crept in him. (TA.) See also تَفَشَّى .

headwords.gloss: They walked; went on foot, one towards; to, another
headwords.def: تَمَاشَوْا They walked, or went on foot, one towards, or to, another. (TA.)

headwords.def: اِسْتَمْشَى بِالدَّوَآءِ [ He used the medicine as a laxative or purgative. (IbrD.)] (Az in L, art. عقر .) اِسْتَمْشَى بِهِ , referring to a plant, (K in art. صع ,) He drank its water (i. e. infusion or the like ) for moving the bowels. (TA ibid.)

headwords.gloss: That goes with energy; a good; strong goer; strong to walk

parts.t: That goes with energy; a good

headwords.def: مَشَّآءٌ [ That goes with energy; a good or strong goer; ] strong to walk, or go, or go on foot. (TA voce رِجِيلٌ .)

headwords.gloss: Medicine that moves; purges, the bowels
headwords.def: دَوَآءُ المَشِىِّ Medicine that moves, or purges, the bowels. (TA in art. طوس .)

parts.t: goats that are for breeding and gain.

headwords.def: مَاشِيَةٌ A she-camel having numerous offspring. (S, Mgh.) Hence, and مَوَاشٍ , as ominous of good, Camels, and cows, and sheep or goats that are for breeding and gain. (Mgh.)

headwords.gloss: A passage; way, by a place; a walking-place
headwords.def: مَمْشَى A passage, or way, by a place; (TA;) [ a walking-place: the gangway of a ship?]
